votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tannert to approve the consent calendar.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Resolution No. 2025-018R approving an Interlocal Agreement between the City and the Washington County Water Conservancy District regarding the Graveyard Wash Reservoir and the Sand Hollow Mitigation Area.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve Ordinance No. 2025- 062 amending the Tech Ridge Planned Development Mixed Use Zone on approximately 4.9 acres located at 400 South Tech Ridge Parkway, with the reduction in parking as requested by the developer and as detailed by staff in the report.

A motion was made by Councilmember Hughes to approve Ordinance No. 2025-063 amending the City's General Plan future land use map from COM (Commercial) to MDR (Medium Density Residential) on approximately 1.69 acres generally located at the northeast corner of Tuweap Drive and 2000 North.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve Ordinance No. 2025-064 amending the City Zoning Map by changing the zone from A-1 (Agricultural, 40,000 square foot minimum lot size) to R-1-10 (Residential, 10,000 ft² minimum lot size) on approximately 15.11 acres generally located west of the St. George/Washington border and approximately 2600 South.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2025-065 amending portions of Title 10-5 of City Code to modify non- agricultural accessory structure setbacks in Agricultural Zones and remove sections of code, with the amendment that we strike 1a under side yard.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to approve Ordinance No. 2025-066 amending portions of Title 10 of City Code as it relates to accessory dwelling units in the multiple-family residential and mobile home zones.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larkin to approve Ordinance No. 2025-067 amending portions of Title 10 of City Code to modify setback standards in residential zones, modify accessory structure standards, update lot size averaging percentages, and remove sections of code.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Kemp to approve Ordinance No. 2025- 068 amending portions of Title 3 of City Code and repealing a portion of Title 6 of City Code, to place the administration of parade permit requests under the code section governing special events.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Larsen to approve the consent calendar as presented Ordinance No. 2025-069 amending Titles 1 and 3 of City Code to remove outdated references, align with current Utah State law, and update with gender-neutral language.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)

votes.motion: A motion was made by Councilmember Tanner to adjourn.
votes.result: 5-0 Pass (The vote was unanimous and the motion carried.)
